## IMPLEMENTATION APPROACH

### Phase 1: Backend Verification (Current)
1. Verify all backend endpoints are working
2. Test API responses with proper authentication
3. Document any missing endpoints

### Phase 2: Frontend Integration
1. Replace mock data with real API calls
2. Add proper error handling
3. Implement loading states
4. Add toast notifications for actions

### Phase 3: Testing & Polish
1. E2E testing for critical flows
2. Performance optimization
3. Accessibility audit
4. User feedback integration

## DEFINITION OF DONE

- [ ] Button triggers correct action (no placeholder alerts)
- [ ] Data is fetched from/sent to backend API
- [ ] Error states are handled gracefully
- [ ] Loading states shown during operations
- [ ] Success/error feedback shown to user
- [ ] Mobile responsive design verified
- [ ] No console errors in production
